secrets: Electron main/backend only; renderer receives no API key
storage: OpenAI key uses Electron safeStorage under userData, with environment fallback
network: audio/SDP goes to OpenAI only during active realtime listening
governance: receipts retain metadata, not transcript, prompt, or secrets
outbound_actions: no autonomous sender; no deployment or external write authority
review_required: human consent and device/provider readiness before live call
